question.text: Order blocks in advanced technical analysis refer to:

answer.text: Orders placed at round-number prices only
Institutional buying and selling zones that can influence support and resistance levels
Customer orders for physical delivery of securities

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, Order Blocks are institutional buying and selling zones that can influence support and resistance levels by reflecting where large orders have been placed. The Trap: Round-number prices are treated separately as psychological levels in the workbook and should not be confused with order blocks. Government regulation orders and customer physical-delivery orders are unrelated concepts. Note: Order blocks belong to the institutional order-flow set of concepts, distinct from the psychological-level discussion of round-number prices.
